method: Built-in imagegen generated a new atlas using local references, then imagegen made one targeted size/centering/padding correction. Final generated PNG copied with Node fs.copyFileSync(COPYFILE_EXCL), bytes compared identical. No crop, resize, repaint, alpha rewrite, threshold bake or Python image processing.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one NEW transparent PNG combat VFX texture atlas for Cloudstitch, square 1024x1024 target, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells.
Visual style: gentle traditional hand-painted Japanese fantasy animation, warm nostalgic watercolor and cel-paint. Rounded organic design, restrained movement implied in the brushwork, soft 2-3 cel-shaded value shapes, subtle tactile watercolor-paper pigment INSIDE the painted shapes, readable contours. Delicate, kind, airy and warm rather than explosive or aggressive.
Reference image 1: Cloudstitch machine gun, STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Keep its cream cloth and aged pale-honey brass warmth, sage shadows and painted illustration quality. Do not depict the gun.
Reference image 2: PREVIOUS ATLAS TO REPLACE IN SPIRIT. Its sharp flame spikes, saturated orange, huge violent explosion and heavy dirty smoke are specifically UNWANTED. Do NOT copy its shapes or intensity.
Layout is strict: a square texture with four separate isolated sprites centered in the four equal quadrants. EACH effect must fit inside the CENTRAL 60% of its own cell in BOTH directions. Keep the remaining outer 20% margins of EACH cell completely empty with ALPHA ZERO. This must produce broad totally transparent gutters along the middle horizontal and vertical cross and the outer image edges. No painted fleck, dust, glow, fog, cast shadow, grain or nearly-transparent haze may extend into the empty margins. Do not enlarge sprites to fill their cells. No grid or border is visible.
TOP LEFT: SMALL ROUNDED DIRECTIONAL MUZZLE PUFF traveling horizontally TO THE RIGHT. Soft cream main puff with pale-honey underside, a gentle round nose and two tiny curved trailing strokes on the left. More like a warm hand-painted puff of air and light; no sharp tongue of flame, no starburst.
TOP RIGHT: SOFT SCALLOPED IMPACT BURST. Ivory center, a few small rounded pale-apricot lobes, and only 3-4 fine curved ochre accent strokes. Gentle asymmetric composition with generous negative gaps. No wood chunks, debris, jagged fire, spiky explosion, dazzling glare, radial ring or violent shards.
BOTTOM LEFT: AIRY ROUNDED SMOKE made from THREE soft cloud lobes. Cream highlight planes with subdued sage and a trace of light lilac shadow; small transparent notches between lobes. Light clean watercolor, not a thick dark or dirty cloud. No noisy grain outside the three-lobe shape.
BOTTOM RIGHT: SHORT NARROW PAINTED COMET TRAIL directed horizontally TO THE RIGHT, rounded cream-honey head and a soft slender leftward trailing brush ribbon, 2-3 pale warm color layers. Short, quiet and graceful; no spear tip, flame spikes, long fiery tongues or energetic blast.
Palette: warm ivory, pale honey, pale apricot, gentle sage, a trace of muted lilac, fine muted ochre edges. Low-to-moderate saturation; no bright saturated orange or scarlet.
True transparent background and alpha-zero empty space around all four sprites. Natural soft fringe is permitted ONLY immediately on the painted silhouette; no full-cell translucent wash.
No text, glyphs, numbers, symbols, logos, characters, film scenes, recognizable props, grid, borders, checkerboard, backdrop, UI, watermark. No flat vector art, low-poly 3D, photorealistic PBR, neon, bloom, hard glossy highlights or grainy noisy fire. This is an original effect sheet, not a reproduction of any existing film scene or character.
attempts.reason: Gentler rounded style achieved, but visible shapes intruded into requested 12% padding; corrected through imagegen rather than editing PNG pixels.

validation.inspection_method: Read-only PNG IHDR/IDAT inflate/filter decode with Node built-ins. Per-cell alpha bounds measured; no image rewrite.
observations_ko: 네 셀은 동일627×627이며 가시형상은 각셀 중앙에 충분한 여백을 두고 완전 분리된다.
강한 주황 불꽃과 목재 파편이 제거되고 크림·연꿀빛·살구·세이지·라일락의 둥근 구아슈/셀 명암으로 바뀌었다.
원본 알파와 생성 PNG를 그대로 보존했다.
limitations_ko: 요청한 엄격12% alpha0 padding은 false다. 그 여백에 959개 픽셀의 alpha1/255 극미세잔여가 있으나, 가시형상 alpha>8은 최소132px(셀의21.05%) 여백을 확보한다.
요청한1024×1024 목표와 달리 도구 결과는1254×1254다. 사이즈를 변경하지 않고 보존했다.
표현은 PNG 스프라이트이며 3D GLB 형상/내장 애니메이션이 아니다. 실제3D탄체와 시간연출은 root 담당이다.
선체·무기 장면 합성, 실제게임크기·깊이·가림·모션·다운로드·브라우저 검수는 이 이미지 작업에서 실행하지 않았다.
